name: SkyFactory Expansion
changelog:
Update 22.1: same world; let PackSync update before you join (the server restarts).
- If something comes back to you from a dream (including a dream reward) and your inventory is full, it now waits for you instead of going into your crafting grid. It arrives by itself once there is room for the whole stack, even if you log off and back on, or die in between. You get a chat message when items start waiting and when they arrive.
- Worn accessories (Curios) that cannot go back into their slot still drop at your feet, as before.
- Items that were caught during a dream trip that never started properly are no longer lost. They come back to you or wait for you.
- If the dream cannot safely store your belongings, it still sends you straight back out with everything you carry.
- A dream "dive" that was about to happen no longer pulls you back in after you have already left the dream. A dream entry that gets cancelled before it starts now cleans up after itself, and gives back an item the dream needed (such as the Dystopic Ruins key).
- In creative mode, waiting items are held until you switch back to survival.
- If the server crashes while you are in a dream, you may come back with the items you had at the last save. Tell the server owner if something is missing.
